description:
* Provide daily application support including monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving incidents for assigned applications.
* Analyze system issues by understanding application logic, data flow, and business rules; work closely with development teams to validate findings.
* Coordinate with internal teams (infrastructure, development, security) and vendors to ensure timely resolution and effective communication.
* Support problem management by conducting root‑cause analysis (RCA) for recurring or high‑severity issues.
* Maintain high‑quality technical documentation, including system flow diagrams, troubleshooting steps, application inventories, deployment procedures, and SOPs.
* Participate in application enhancement and new system development activities, including requirements clarification, understanding design documents, and supporting UAT/testing.
* Perform backend checks (e.g., SQL queries, system logs, configuration validation) to support issue investigation.
* Prepare regular reports including incident summaries, trend analysis, and improvement recommendations.
* Participate in after‑hours/on‑call support when required for major incidents.
requirements_text:
* Proficiency in English (written and spoken) to communicate with regional teams and vendors.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in Application Support, IT Operations, or a similar technical role.
* Solid understanding of application architecture:
+ System design concepts
+ Backend–frontend interaction
+ API and integration flows
+ Database structure and queries
* Ability to read and interpret basic code logic (e.g., Java, .NET, Python, SQL) to understand root causes—actual coding not required.
* Familiarity with SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) and Agile/Waterfall development methodologies.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, able to break down complex issues into understandable components.
* Experience with ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change).
* Good documentation skills: flowcharts, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, user manuals.
* Basic experience using SQL and working with application logs.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage communication during critical issues.
